spirits.lore: Spirits said to possess people, calmed with music, drumming and dance.

spirits.name: Tokoloshe
spirits.lore: A small, mischievous spirit; people raise their beds on bricks to stay out of its reach.

spirits.name: Bhoot
spirits.lore: A restless ghost whose feet face backwards and casts no shadow.

spirits.name: Patupaiarehe
spirits.lore: Pale fairy folk of the misty hills who play haunting flute music.

spirits.name: Tuatara (Spirit)
spirits.lore: The spirit of the tuatara, the ancient lizard of New Zealand.

spirits.name: Slenderman
spirits.lore: A faceless figure in a black suit at the edge of the woods.

spirits.name: Banshee
spirits.lore: A wailing spirit whose cry foretells a death in the family.

spirits.name: Yuki-onna
spirits.lore: The Snow Woman, who freezes lost travellers with her icy breath.

spirits.name: Tengu
spirits.lore: A red-faced mountain spirit with a long nose and great pride.

spirits.name: Rokurokubi
spirits.lore: A woman whose neck stretches impossibly long at night.

spirits.name: Glühschwanz
spirits.lore: A "glowing tail", a fiery spirit seen streaking across the night.

spirits.name: Djinn
spirits.lore: Beings of smokeless fire who live unseen alongside humans.

spirits.name: Zar
spirits.lore: Spirits said to possess people, calmed with music and dance.

spirits.name: Kasa-obake
spirits.lore: An old umbrella that comes to life with one eye and one leg.

spirits.name: Ubume
spirits.lore: The ghost of a mother who asks passers-by to hold her baby.

spirits.name: Kodama
spirits.lore: A tree spirit; the echo in the mountains is its answer.

spirits.name: Hitotsume-kozō
spirits.lore: A one-eyed child spirit who startles people and runs away.

spirits.name: Yamawaro
spirits.lore: A one-eyed mountain child spirit who helps woodcutters.

spirits.name: Zashiki-warashi
spirits.lore: A child spirit that brings good fortune to a house, and ruin when it leaves.

spirits.name: Leshy
spirits.lore: The lord of the forest, who leads travellers in circles.

spirits.name: Domovoi
spirits.lore: A bearded household spirit who must be kept happy.

spirits.name: El Sombrerón
spirits.lore: A tiny man in a huge hat who braids horses' manes and serenades girls.

spirits.name: Tawhaki
spirits.lore: A Māori hero of the old stories, said to have climbed to the heavens.

spirits.name: Patupaiarehe
spirits.lore: Pale fairy folk of the misty hills who play haunting flute music.

spirits.name: Mauikeli
spirits.lore: A spirit of the islands.

spirits.name: Torch Wraith
spirits.lore: A spirit carrying a lantern that leads travellers off the path.

spirits.name: Bell Spirit
spirits.lore: A spirit that rings old bells to warn of danger.

spirits.name: Fog Wanderer
spirits.lore: A spirit made of fog that drifts across lonely moors.

spirits.name: Bridge Spirit
spirits.lore: A spirit that guards an old stone bridge and demands a toll.

spirits.name: Well Wraith
spirits.lore: A spirit that lives in the bottom of a well.

spirits.name: Harvest Shade
spirits.lore: A scarecrow ghost that walks the fields at harvest time.

spirits.name: Sailor's Ghost
spirits.lore: A drowned sailor who still keeps watch on the shore.

spirits.name: Whispering Mist
spirits.lore: A mist that whispers your name.

spirits.name: War Spirit
spirits.lore: The ghost of a soldier still fighting a long-lost battle.

spirits.name: Road Ghost
spirits.lore: A hooded figure who appears on lonely roads at night.

spirits.name: Empty Husk
spirits.lore: A hollow spirit left behind when a soul departs.

spirits.name: Petrified Soul
spirits.lore: A soul turned to stone, still trying to speak.

spirits.name: River Woman
spirits.lore: A spirit of the river who appears pale and silent on the bank.

spirits.name: Rain Spirit
spirits.lore: A spirit who arrives with the rain and leaves with it.

spirits.name: Smoke Wraith
spirits.lore: A wraith of smoke that rises from old chimneys.

spirits.name: Tree Spirit
spirits.lore: The spirit of an ancient tree.

spirits.name: House Shade
spirits.lore: A spirit bound to an old, empty house.

spirits.name: Field Wisp
spirits.lore: A wisp that drifts across fields at dusk.

spirits.name: War Spirit
spirits.lore: The spirit of a soldier who never left the battlefield.

spirits.name: Bound Soul
spirits.lore: A soul trapped between this world and the next.

spirits.name: Starling Spirit
spirits.lore: A spirit that rides with flocks of starlings.

spirits.name: Hollow Echo
spirits.lore: A spirit that repeats the last words of the dead.

spirits.name: Mist Idol
spirits.lore: A spirit made of mist, worshipped in forgotten shrines.

spirits.name: Lost Pilgrim
spirits.lore: The spirit of a pilgrim who never reached the end of the road.
